title: A Sunday Morning at the Market

sentences.en: My name is Li Mei, and I am twelve years old.
sentences.zh: 我叫李梅，今年十二岁。

sentences.en: I live in a small town near a wide, slow river.
sentences.zh: 我住在一条宽阔舒缓的河边小镇上。

sentences.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
sentences.zh: 星期日是我一周中最喜欢的日子。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, I always go to the market with my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 每个星期日早上，我总是和奶奶一起去市场。

sentences.en: We get up early, before the sun is hot.
sentences.zh: 我们起得很早，趁太阳还没变热。

sentences.en: Grandmother wakes me at six o'clock with a gentle knock on my door.
sentences.zh: 六点钟，奶奶轻轻敲我的房门叫醒我。

sentences.en: "The best vegetables sell out early," she always says with a smile.
sentences.zh: "最好的菜很早就卖完了。"她总是笑着说。

sentences.en: First, we eat a quick breakfast of eggs and warm rice.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们快速吃一顿鸡蛋加热米饭的早餐。

sentences.en: Then we walk together to the bus stop at the end of our street.
sentences.zh: 然后我们一起走到街尾的公交车站。

sentences.en: The bus is our transport to the town market.
sentences.zh: 公交车是我们去镇上市场的交通工具。

sentences.en: The ride takes about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 车程大约二十分钟。

sentences.en: From the window, I watch green fields run past like a slow film.
sentences.zh: 透过车窗，我看着绿色的田野像慢电影一样掠过。

sentences.en: Farmers are already working in the morning light.
sentences.zh: 农民们已经在晨光里劳作了。

sentences.en: The market is loud and full of life.
sentences.zh: 市场喧闹而充满生机。

sentences.en: It is a rainbow of colors and a sea of sounds.
sentences.zh: 它是色彩的彩虹，也是声音的海洋。

sentences.en: "Fresh fish! Fresh fish this morning!" a seller calls across the square.
sentences.zh: "鲜鱼！今早的鲜鱼！"一个摊贩隔着广场吆喝。

sentences.en: Red apples sit in tall, shining piles.
sentences.zh: 红苹果堆成亮闪闪的小山。

sentences.en: Green vegetables stand in buckets of cool water.
sentences.zh: 绿色蔬菜立在一桶桶凉水里。

sentences.en: Grandmother knows every good seller in the market by name.
sentences.zh: 奶奶叫得出市场里每个好摊贩的名字。

sentences.en: She stops at Mr. Chen's fruit stand first.
sentences.zh: 她先在陈先生的水果摊前停下。

sentences.en: "Good morning, Auntie Li!" says Mr. Chen with a wide smile.
sentences.zh: "李奶奶早上好！"陈先生咧嘴笑着说。

sentences.en: He cuts a small piece of mango for me to try.
sentences.zh: 他切了一小块芒果给我尝。

sentences.en: It tastes sweet, like yellow sunshine.
sentences.zh: 它尝起来很甜，像黄色的阳光。

sentences.en: "Two kilos, please," says my grandmother.
sentences.zh: "请来两公斤。"我奶奶说。

sentences.en: Mr. Chen puts the mangoes into a strong paper bag.
sentences.zh: 陈先生把芒果装进一个结实的纸袋。

sentences.en: He tells us that some of his fruit is imported from the warm south.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他的一部分水果是从温暖的南方进口来的。

sentences.en: "It travels three days by truck to reach this little town," he says.
sentences.zh: "这些水果要坐三天卡车才能到这个小镇。"他说。

sentences.en: Next, we walk to the fish tables near the market gate.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们走向市场门口附近的鱼摊。

sentences.en: The fish are still cold and silver from the river.
sentences.zh: 鱼还是河里捞上来的，又凉又银亮。

sentences.en: "Look at this one," Grandmother says, pointing at a fat carp.
sentences.zh: "看这条。"奶奶指着一条肥鲤鱼说。

sentences.en: "Its eyes are clear, so it is fresh."
sentences.zh: "它的眼睛清亮，所以很新鲜。"

sentences.en: She turns the fish over and looks at it carefully.
sentences.zh: 她把鱼翻过来，仔细看了看。

sentences.en: "We will take this one home for lunch," she tells the seller.
sentences.zh: "这条我们带回家当午饭。"她对摊主说。

sentences.en: A porter moves past us with a huge box on his back.
sentences.zh: 一个搬运工背着一个大箱子从我们身边走过。

sentences.en: He walks slowly and carefully between the narrow tables.
sentences.zh: 他在窄窄的摊位之间缓慢而小心地走着。

sentences.en: Everyone moves out of his way with respect.
sentences.zh: 所有人都尊敬地给他让路。

sentences.en: He wears a small portable radio on his belt.
sentences.zh: 他腰上别着一台小便携收音机。

sentences.en: Soft music follows him like a quiet river through the market.
sentences.zh: 轻柔的音乐跟着他，像一条安静的小河穿过市场。

sentences.en: Grandmother buys fish, eggs, tofu, and a big bag of rice.
sentences.zh: 奶奶买了鱼、鸡蛋、豆腐和一大袋米。

sentences.en: She also buys a small bunch of yellow flowers for the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 她还买了一小束黄花，准备摆在厨房桌上。

sentences.en: "A market without flowers is like soup without salt," she jokes.
sentences.zh: "没有花的市场就像没放盐的汤。"她打趣道。

sentences.en: The bags are too heavy for her small arms.
sentences.zh: 这些袋子对她瘦小的胳膊来说太重了。

sentences.en: So the kind porter carries them all the way to the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 于是好心的搬运工一路把袋子搬到了公交车站。

sentences.en: "Thank you so much," says Grandmother, pressing a coin into his hand.
sentences.zh: "太感谢你了。"奶奶说着，把一枚硬币塞进他手里。

sentences.en: On the ride home, I hold the bag of mangoes on my knees.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，我把那袋芒果抱在膝盖上。

sentences.en: The bus rocks gently, like a boat on the slow river.
sentences.zh: 公交车轻轻地摇晃，像慢河上的一条小船。

sentences.en: At home, the whole kitchen smells of fish and spring onions.
sentences.zh: 到家后，整个厨房都是鱼和葱花的香味。

sentences.en: Grandmother cooks while I wash the vegetables.
sentences.zh: 奶奶做饭，我洗菜。

sentences.en: Steam rises from the pot like little white clouds.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽从锅里升起，像一朵朵小白云。

sentences.en: At noon, my parents and my little brother come home.
sentences.zh: 中午，爸爸妈妈和弟弟回家了。

sentences.en: We eat together around the big round table.
sentences.zh: 我们围坐在大圆桌旁一起吃饭。

sentences.en: Everyone says the fish is the best in town.
sentences.zh: 大家都说这是全镇最好吃的鱼。

sentences.en: Grandmother laughs and says the secret is a fresh market and an early bus.
sentences.zh: 奶奶笑着说，秘诀就是新鲜的市场加上早班车。

sentences.en: After lunch, I write in my diary about the morning.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，我在日记里写下这个上午。

sentences.en: I write about the colors, the songs, and the sweet smell of mango.
sentences.zh: 我写下那些颜色、那些歌声和芒果的甜香。

sentences.en: Ordinary days like this are the ones I remember best.
sentences.zh: 这样平凡的日子，恰恰是我记得最牢的。

questions.q: How do Li Mei and her grandmother travel to the market?
questions.explain: 第10句 "The bus is our transport to the town market"，公交车是他们的交通工具。

questions.q: How does Grandmother know that the fish is fresh?
questions.explain: "Its eyes are clear, so it is fresh" —— 眼睛清亮就说明鱼新鲜。

questions.q: Why does everyone move out of the porter's way?
options: Because they respect his hard work.
questions.explain: "Everyone moves out of his way with respect" —— 出于对他辛勤劳动的尊敬。

questions.q: According to Grandmother, what is the secret of the best lunch?
options: A fresh market and an early bus.
questions.explain: 结尾奶奶笑答：秘诀是 "a fresh market and an early bus"。
